info.title: Al Barakah MCSL — Member API
info.description: The member-facing surface of /api/v1, consumed by the member mobile application (AD-03). Proposed contract; see docs/member-api.md. The web application generates its own document from route descriptors — once these endpoints exist there, that generated document supersedes this one.

details.description: Field messages keyed subject.ordinal.fieldKey, or document.<code>.

nic.description: National identity card number, exactly as on the card.

abNumber.description: The Member No. on the card (member.member_no), also called the Shares Account Number.

sentTo.description: Masked. For link_member this is the registered mobile, which the caller did not supply.

uploadUrl.description: Scoped PUT URL for the bytes; expires.

memberToken.description: Authentication: the access token from verify-otp or refresh. The server resolves it to member_session and its member_id; NIC and AB Number are never presented again.

get.summary: Read the membership types a person can apply for
get.description: Active membership types with their field configuration, applicant-facing checklist and current fees. Public.

500.description: A defect; quote the correlation id

post.summary: Identify an existing member by NIC + AB Number and send a code to their registered mobile
post.description: Identification only: opens nothing by itself. Exact pair, active members only. Not the staff existing-member-search — no fragments, no names in the response. Rate-limited per NIC, per AB Number and per IP.

200.description: Code sent to the mobile on record; sentTo is masked.

404.description: The pair does not name one active member (one message whichever half was wrong)

500.description: A defect; quote the correlation id

post.summary: Verify a mobile number to start a membership application
post.description: No AB Number needed. Always 200 for a well-formed number, known or not; the session it leads to is an applicant session whoever the number belongs to.

422.description: The number cannot be placed; details.mobile says why

500.description: A defect; quote the correlation id

post.summary: Send a fresh code for an existing challenge

500.description: A defect; quote the correlation id

post.summary: Verify the code and create the session
post.description: Verification. For a link_member challenge this creates the link between the mobile identity and the internal memberId (server-side) and returns a member session; for sign_up, an applicant session.
